item.title: Rollator, Bariatric, Basic Steel, Blue, mechanical walker with four legs and a metal frame intended for medical purposes to provide moderate
item.description: The front fork stem bolt/wheel assembly may disconnect from the rollator frame tubing. If the front fork stem bolt/wheel assembly disconnects from the rollator frame tubing, the front wheels may become loose or detach from the rollator. If the front wheels become loose or detach during use, there is risk of severe adverse events. The immediate consequences could include falls resulting in head trauma, bone fractures, or other critical injuries.
